scope: Three frozen shared models only: exact identity, additive source delta, static Serde and projection contract. No runtime, whole-project, build or legal clearance.

wire_contract.absence: Both input models deserialize a missing native_l010 as None; serde model has explicit default, generator model uses standard Option missing-field behavior.
wire_contract.explicit_null: Both input models deserialize native_l010:null as None.
wire_contract.none_serialization: cw32-data-serde omits native_l010 when None. Explicit input null normalizes to omission. Generator and static models do not implement Serialize.
wire_contract.present_object: All nine native fields are required and nonnullable; numeric widths/types and route element types match. Empty rtc_output_routes is syntactically valid; missing/null is not.
wire_contract.unknown_fields: Both input models deny unknown native-object fields and unknown route fields. Their enclosing LseConfiguration deny_unknown_fields remains intact.
wire_contract.old_inputs: Old mapping/JSON documents without native_l010 retain their prior field types, relative declaration order, defaults and None output omission; this is static proof, not an executed roundtrip.
wire_contract.old_readers: Stage51 LseConfiguration readers reject native_l010 when present, including null, because the old models deny unknown fields.
wire_contract.non_json: No guarantee is made for positional/binary Serde formats or Rust memory layout.

rust_api.literal_change: Existing explicit LseConfiguration literals and exhaustive patterns need native_l010:None or the appropriate Some value / wildcard; generated source must be regenerated alongside its static template.
rust_api.derived_traits: Debug output includes the new field and can change generated Rust bytes; derived Hash in cw32-data-serde now includes an additional Option discriminant even for None. No stable Debug, Hash, ABI or source-compatibility claim.
rust_api.projection: Owned String/Vec input types correspond to static str/static slice metadata. Option wraps the native record by value. Static normalized names, widths and order match; generator execution and Rust compilation are not performed here.

source_qualification_boundary.schema_is_not_validation: Serde widths do not enforce 4-bit drive widths, the 36080 Hz bound, detector ratios, positive/correct divisors, part applicability, pad bonding or exact source-qualified routes. Generator/source qualification must enforce those facts.
source_qualification_boundary.routes: rtc_output_routes encodes direct RTC output pad pin/AF facts. It does not by itself encode or prove disconnection of all internal BTIM/GTIM/ATIM/LPTIM routes or external recipients.
source_qualification_boundary.runtime: No proof of STABLE frequency legality, active monitoring, RTC observer isolation, GPIOB noninterference, entry safety, RTC timing or preservation of the existing 16 active-LSE parts is supplied by these type declarations.

lineage.required_update: Wrap the entire prior replacement_review object as previous_review. Preserve every nested object, accepted extension, accepted component review, identity, compatibility note and referenced evidence; do not flatten or reconstruct only a hash list.
lineage.required_classification: Keep serde reviewed_independent_replacement and its original ancestry. Keep both metapac models explicit_upstream_package_declaration with adapted upstream ancestry and historical observations unchanged.
lineage.full_source_release_identity_review: Required separately against final integration freeze; not established by this frozen three-file receipt.
